note: The example catalog. The demo site, docs and tests read it; add an entry when you add an example.

examples.title: iOS toggle
examples.summary: The toggle with Apple's motion: SwiftUI's snappy spring for the knob, a quick non-bouncing one for the color. Only the import differs from the Material switch.
prompts: Switch this toggle to Material motion by changing only the import.
Make it bouncier using Apple's own preset names.

examples.title: Material switch
examples.summary: A Material 3 switch with the Expressive motion scheme: the handle grows and slides with the spatial spring, colors change with the effects spring, which never bounces.
prompts: Switch this to the Material standard scheme and tell me what changed in the feel.
Use the fast spatial spring for the handle.

examples.title: Toggle
examples.summary: The knob springs; the color tweens. Tap again mid-flight: the spring keeps its velocity.
prompts: Make the toggle a little bouncier, then show me a before/after plot.
Make the color change faster than the knob.

examples.title: Toggle with press
examples.summary: Two parallel regions: checked, and a knob that shrinks while pressed. Turning off settles without overshoot.
prompts: Make the knob shrink more while pressed.
Make turning off bounce as much as turning on.

examples.title: Draggable toggle
examples.summary: Drag the knob, or flick it. On release it springs to where the throw was heading, carrying your finger's speed. The color is mapped from the knob's position.
prompts: Make it harder to pull the knob past the ends.
Make a quick flick cross over more easily.

examples.title: Button press
examples.summary: The button sinks quickly while pressed and springs back with a little bounce on release.
prompts: Make the release bouncier.
Make the press sink deeper but slower.

examples.title: Hover card
examples.summary: The card lifts on hover and settles under a press. Hover and press are parallel regions on different properties.
prompts: Lift the card higher on hover, with a softer spring.
Add a slight tilt on hover.

examples.title: Like
examples.summary: A kick adds velocity to the heart's scale without changing its target, so it pops and settles. The motions come from an imported brand library.
prompts: Make the pop twice as strong.
Make every motion in the brand library snappier.

examples.title: Swipe row
examples.summary: Swipe left to reveal Delete. A short or slow swipe snaps back; a long or quick one stays open. The action fades in through a map.
prompts: Make the row easier to open with a short swipe.
Make the delete action fade in later.

examples.title: Accordion
examples.summary: The panel opens to exactly its content's height, measured from the page; it springs without overshoot, its content fades, and the chevron turns.
prompts: Let the panel overshoot a little when it opens.
Make the chevron turn a bit before the panel opens.

examples.title: Carousel
examples.summary: Drag the strip and release: it snaps to the nearest slide, carrying the finger's speed. The dots cross-fade through a map.
prompts: Make the slides snap more firmly, with no bounce.
Make it easier to flick to the next slide.

examples.title: Pull to refresh
examples.summary: The list follows the finger with growing resistance, the spinner fades and grows with the pull, and a release past halfway holds the list open until the app reports it's done. While refreshing, CSS spins the spinner through the state attribute nudg sets.
prompts: Require a longer pull before it refreshes.
Make the list spring back with more bounce.

examples.title: Segmented control
examples.summary: Tap a segment to move the indicator, or drag it and let it snap. Transitions are listed once on the machine, not once per state.
prompts: Make the indicator move with a bit of overshoot.
Add a fourth segment.

examples.title: Tabs
examples.summary: The underline slides under the selected tab and takes its width, measured from the labels, so renaming a tab needs no new numbers.
prompts: Make the underline lag a little behind, like it's being pulled.
Let the underline stretch toward the new tab before it moves.

examples.title: Bottom sheet
examples.summary: Three resting points: closed, half and full. Drag between them; on release it settles at the nearest, judged by where the throw was heading. The scrim is mapped from the sheet's position.
prompts: Make the sheet snap to full more easily when flicked up.
Darken the scrim more when the sheet is fully open.

examples.title: Toast
examples.summary: The app shows it; it hides itself after 3 s (a timer, restarted by another show) or on tap. It rises with a soft spring while fading in.
prompts: Keep the toast up for 5 seconds instead of 3.
Make the toast slide in from the right instead of from below.

examples.title: Shake on error
examples.summary: The field shakes and turns red when the app rejects it. The shake is a kick with a bouncy spring, so it's real motion, not keyframes.
prompts: Make the shake shorter and sharper.
Shake vertically instead of horizontally.

examples.title: Slider
examples.summary: Drag the thumb and it stays where you leave it; arrow keys move it a step, Home and End to the ends, all within the property's bounds. The fill is mapped from the thumb. WAI-ARIA slider pattern.
prompts: Make the arrow keys move the thumb by half as much.
Let the thumb bounce a little more when it lands.

examples.title: Tooltip
examples.summary: Hover or focus the trigger and the tip appears after 500 ms, unless you leave first; Escape or leaving hides it. WAI-ARIA tooltip pattern.
prompts: Show the tooltip sooner, after 200 ms.
Make it fade out slower than it fades in.

examples.title: Dialog
examples.summary: A modal that scales and fades in over a scrim; Escape, the scrim or the button closes it. The scrim's opacity is mapped from the dialog's. WAI-ARIA dialog pattern.
prompts: Open the dialog with more bounce.
Slide the dialog up from the bottom instead of scaling.

examples.title: Microphone level
examples.summary: The app reads microphone loudness and supplies one number; mapped rings respond every frame. The device API stays in the host, outside nudg.
prompts: Make quiet sounds affect the ring more strongly.
Make the glow grow less than the outline.

examples.title: Shrinking app bar
examples.summary: The DOM adapter reports scroll position; the sticky app bar shrinks and its accent fades through ordinary maps.
prompts: Keep the app bar large for the first 20 pixels of scrolling.
Make the accent fade later than the header shrinks.
